label: confirmshaming
_note: Decline-control copy. label 1 = the decline is phrased so that choosing it means saying something unflattering about yourself. label 0 = a plain, neutral decline, or ordinary page prose. The negatives are the important half: a classifier that fires on every 'No thanks' button on the web makes the extension unusable, so neutral declines are heavily represented.
_provenance: Hand-written by the author from patterns observed in the wild and documented in Gray et al. (2018) and Mathur et al. (2019). NOT sampled from a corpus, and small — see EVAL.md. Any performance number from this set is an upper bound on a convenience sample, not an estimate of field accuracy.
